title: Land Reform and the Trauma of Collectivization
grammar: Benefactive and redistributive postposition: javára ('in favor of / to the benefit of')
goal: I can recount the 1945 land reform and the subsequent forced collectivization campaign.
I can use the compound postposition javára to express transfer, advantage, and beneficiary status.
I can analyze historical trauma, agricultural cooperatives, and peasant dispossession in B2 Hungarian.
